items_all.title: Zenity募資1.25億美元，擴大AI代理安全佈局
items_all.summary: 隨著企業開始讓AI代理存取系統與資料、呼叫工具並直接執行工作，安全風險也從AI模型本身延伸到代理實際採取的動作。專注AI代理安全與治理的資安業者Zenity宣佈完成1.25億美元C輪募資。Zenity表示，新資金將用於持續開發旗下平臺、擴大資安研究團隊Zenity Labs，以及拓展歐洲與亞太市場。

items_all.title: 開放權重AI模型能力逼近封閉模型，抵禦攻擊表現未同步提升
items_all.summary: 開放權重AI模型正快速縮小與頂尖封閉模型的能力差距。網路應用與資安業者F5旗下研究團隊F5 Labs指出，根據AI研究機構Epoch AI分析，自2026年1月以來，最強開放權重模型的能力平均落後頂尖封閉模型約4個月；不過F5的AI安全評測顯示，部分開放權重模型雖躋身能力排名前段，在抵禦提示注入與越獄攻擊的評測中卻排名後段。

items_all.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands
items_all.summary: NVIDIA has released TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project that takes a supported Hugging Face or local checkpoint to end-to-end TensorRT inference in two commands, with no intermediate ONNX export. The build emits a versioned .bundle artifact that runs through native C++ task APIs, so inference executes without PyTorch in the runtime path. NVIDIA's July 29, 2026 GB300 snapshot covers 105 release profiles across 76 model families. The post NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 輝達 已釋出 TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) 公共預覽版，這是一個 Apache-2.0 專案，它採用受支援的 Hugging Face 或本地檢查點，透過兩個命令進行端到端 TensorRT 推理，無需中間 ONNX 匯出。該構建會發出一個版本化的 .bundle 工件，該工件透過本機 C++ 任務 API 執行，因此在執行時路徑中無需 PyTorch 即可執行推理。 輝達的 2026 年 7 月 29 日 GB300 快照涵蓋 76 個型號系列的 105 個版本配置檔案。 輝達 釋出 TensorRT 模型連線公共預覽版：Hugging Face 檢查點到兩個命令中的本機 C++ 推理一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.summary: OpenAI is deliberately "pacing AI model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities. A new monitoring system triggers an alert within 30 minutes if a model shows suspicious behavior. The article OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 有意“加快人工智慧模型開發速度”，部分原因是即將推出的“Astra”模型可能即將獲得關鍵的網路攻擊能力。如果模型表現出可疑行為，新的監控系統會在 30 分鐘內觸發警報。文章 OpenAI 表示，隨著人工智慧網路安全風險變得過於危險，它正在“調整模型開發”，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: New benchmark ranks search APIs for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed
items_all.summary: Artificial Analysis has released the "Search Index," a benchmark that rates search API providers for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed. Of seven providers tested with GPT-5.6 Luna, Parallel, Exa, and Firecrawl scored highest. The article New benchmark ranks search APIs for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Artificial Analysis 釋出了“搜尋指數”，這是一個對人工智慧代理的搜尋 API 提供商的品質、成本和速度進行評級的基準。在使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 進行測試的七個提供商中，Parallel、Exa 和 Firecrawl 得分最高。文章《新基準對人工智慧代理的搜尋 API 的品質、成本和速度進行排名》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents
items_all.summary: Google has open-sourced SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh) under Apache-2.0 — and it has nothing to do with Segment Anything. SAM is a zero-config, zero-trust P2P overlay that lets autonomous agents discover and call each other's MCP tools across cloud, on-prem, laptop and edge environments, without exposing a single internal endpoint to the public internet. Identity flows from OIDC into Biscuit capability tokens, so nodes authorize every request offline under a strict default-deny model. The post Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 在 Apache-2.0 下開源了 SAM（主權代理網格）——它與 Segment Anything 無關。 SAM 是一種零配置、零信任的 P2P 覆蓋層，允許自主代理跨雲、本地、膝上型電腦和邊緣環境發現並呼叫彼此的 MCP 工具，而無需將單個內部端點暴露到公共網際網路。身份從 OIDC 流入 Biscuit 功能令牌，因此節點在嚴格的預設拒絕模型下離線授權每個請求。認識 SAM（主權代理網格）：用於 AI 代理的零配置、零信任 P2P 網路首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.title: Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips
items_all.summary: An open fight over AI regulation has broken out on X. Investor Gavin Baker, former White House adviser David Sacks, and Meta researcher Yann LeCun accuse Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei of using fear rhetoric to buy himself a regulatory advantage. Amodei counters that regulation can also rein in corporate power, and that open models alone just shift power toward the players with the most computing muscle. The article Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: X 上爆發了一場關於人工智慧監管的公開鬥爭。投資者 Gavin Baker、前白宮顧問 David Sacks 和 Meta 研究員 Yann LeCun 指責 Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 使用恐懼言論為自己贏得監管優勢。阿莫代反駁說，監管也可以限制企業權力，而開放模型本身只會將權力轉移給擁有最強計算能力的參與者。 Anthropic 執行長表示人工智慧本質上是中心化的，開放模型只是將權力轉移給擁有晶片的人，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas
items_all.summary: Cartesia has released Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models rather than transformers. It now ranks #1 on both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards — 1,283 Elo on Provider Voice and 1,123 on Controlled Voice, the board that clones every model onto the same eight reference voices to isolate the synthesis engine. Cartesia states sub-90ms time-to-first-audio. The model is available in beta on Cartesia's own API The post Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Cartesia 釋出了 Sonic-3.6，這是一種基於狀態空間模型而不是 Transformer 構建的流式文字到語音模型。現在，它在人工分析語音排行榜上均排名第一，在 Provider Voice 上排名 1,283 Elo，在 Controlled Voice 上排名 1,123，該排行榜將每個模型克隆到相同的八個參考語音上以隔離合成引擎。 Cartesia 表示首個音訊的時間低於 90 毫秒。該模型已在 Cartesia 自己的 API 上提供測試版。Cartesia 釋出了 Sonic-3.6：目前引領人工分析語音競技場的流式 TTS 模型，該模型首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.title: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
items_all.summary: When AI systems condense long conversations, they drop an average of 83 percent of user rules, like "don't send emails without my approval." Penn State researchers propose a small add-on module built on Qwen3.5-9B that preserves over 90 percent of these restrictions. The article AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 當人工智慧系統壓縮長對話時，它們平均會放棄 83% 的使用者規則，例如“未經我批准，請勿傳送電子郵件”。賓夕法尼亞州立大學的研究人員提出了一個基於 Qwen3.5-9B 構建的小型附加模組，該模組保留了 90% 以上的限制。文章《人工智慧系統在壓縮上下文時悄悄地丟棄使用者指令》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.summary: 近年全球政府與科技大廠相繼公佈PQC遷移時程藍圖，突顯這場密碼體系轉換之路已經迫在眉睫，多年來在臺灣持續呼籲各界重視升級PQC演演算法標準的臺灣大學數學系兼任助理教授陳君明，近日特別點出技術落地實務上，產業正持續克服的兩大障礙。 PQC遷移不只是單純的軟體升級，同時也在要求企業對整個網路架構進行重新規畫與部署。談及PQC演演算法對網路架構帶來的衝擊，陳君明歸納出兩個關鍵面向。

items_all.title: Mojo🔥 is now open source
items_all.summary: Mojo🔥 is now open source Mojo🔥 is now open source The Mojo programming language has been promising an open source release since May 2023 . Last week they shipped their 1.0 and today they have followed through on that original promise, releasing the compiler and toolchain under an Apache 2 license. When Mojo first launched the stated goal was to produce a superset of Python, so existing Python code could be used to bootstrap their own ecosystem. That plan changed around August 2025 : Mojo may or may not evolve into a full superset of Python, and it’s okay if it doesn’t. We’re encouraged by how well AI-assisted coding tools already help migrate Python to Mojo today, and we’re confident that future tooling and ecosystem maturity will make this evolution even smoother. Today Mojo is its own language, optimized to make GPU programming as painless as possible using syntax inspired by Python, if not 100% compatible with existing code. Via Lobste.rs Tags: open-source , python , mojo

items_all_raw.title: 開放權重AI模型能力逼近封閉模型，抵禦攻擊表現未同步提升
items_all_raw.summary: 開放權重AI模型正快速縮小與頂尖封閉模型的能力差距。網路應用與資安業者F5旗下研究團隊F5 Labs指出，根據AI研究機構Epoch AI分析，自2026年1月以來，最強開放權重模型的能力平均落後頂尖封閉模型約4個月；不過F5的AI安全評測顯示，部分開放權重模型雖躋身能力排名前段，在抵禦提示注入與越獄攻擊的評測中卻排名後段。

items_all_raw.title: Zenity募資1.25億美元，擴大AI代理安全佈局
items_all_raw.summary: 隨著企業開始讓AI代理存取系統與資料、呼叫工具並直接執行工作，安全風險也從AI模型本身延伸到代理實際採取的動作。專注AI代理安全與治理的資安業者Zenity宣佈完成1.25億美元C輪募資。Zenity表示，新資金將用於持續開發旗下平臺、擴大資安研究團隊Zenity Labs，以及拓展歐洲與亞太市場。

items_all_raw.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands
items_all_raw.summary: NVIDIA has released TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project that takes a supported Hugging Face or local checkpoint to end-to-end TensorRT inference in two commands, with no intermediate ONNX export. The build emits a versioned .bundle artifact that runs through native C++ task APIs, so inference executes without PyTorch in the runtime path. NVIDIA's July 29, 2026 GB300 snapshot covers 105 release profiles across 76 model families. The post NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達 已釋出 TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) 公共預覽版，這是一個 Apache-2.0 專案，它採用受支援的 Hugging Face 或本地檢查點，透過兩個命令進行端到端 TensorRT 推理，無需中間 ONNX 匯出。該構建會發出一個版本化的 .bundle 工件，該工件透過本機 C++ 任務 API 執行，因此在執行時路徑中無需 PyTorch 即可執行推理。 輝達的 2026 年 7 月 29 日 GB300 快照涵蓋 76 個型號系列的 105 個版本配置檔案。 輝達 釋出 TensorRT 模型連線公共預覽版：Hugging Face 檢查點到兩個命令中的本機 C++ 推理一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all_raw.title: Mojo🔥 is now open source
items_all_raw.summary: Mojo🔥 is now open source Mojo🔥 is now open source The Mojo programming language has been promising an open source release since May 2023 . Last week they shipped their 1.0 and today they have followed through on that original promise, releasing the compiler and toolchain under an Apache 2 license. When Mojo first launched the stated goal was to produce a superset of Python, so existing Python code could be used to bootstrap their own ecosystem. That plan changed around August 2025 : Mojo may or may not evolve into a full superset of Python, and it’s okay if it doesn’t. We’re encouraged by how well AI-assisted coding tools already help migrate Python to Mojo today, and we’re confident that future tooling and ecosystem maturity will make this evolution even smoother. Today Mojo is its own language, optimized to make GPU programming as painless as possible using syntax inspired by Python, if not 100% compatible with existing code. Via Lobste.rs Tags: open-source , python , mojo

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is deliberately "pacing AI model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities. A new monitoring system triggers an alert within 30 minutes if a model shows suspicious behavior. items_all_raw.title: Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents
items_all_raw.summary: Google has open-sourced SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh) under Apache-2.0 — and it has nothing to do with Segment Anything. SAM is a zero-config, zero-trust P2P overlay that lets autonomous agents discover and call each other's MCP tools across cloud, on-prem, laptop and edge environments, without exposing a single internal endpoint to the public internet. Identity flows from OIDC into Biscuit capability tokens, so nodes authorize every request offline under a strict default-deny model. The post Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 在 Apache-2.0 下開源了 SAM（主權代理網格）——它與 Segment Anything 無關。 SAM 是一種零配置、零信任的 P2P 覆蓋層，允許自主代理跨雲、本地、膝上型電腦和邊緣環境發現並呼叫彼此的 MCP 工具，而無需將單個內部端點暴露到公共網際網路。身份從 OIDC 流入 Biscuit 功能令牌，因此節點在嚴格的預設拒絕模型下離線授權每個請求。認識 SAM（主權代理網格）：用於 AI 代理的零配置、零信任 P2P 網路首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips
items_all_raw.summary: An open fight over AI regulation has broken out on X. Investor Gavin Baker, former White House adviser David Sacks, and Meta researcher Yann LeCun accuse Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei of using fear rhetoric to buy himself a regulatory advantage. Amodei counters that regulation can also rein in corporate power, and that open models alone just shift power toward the players with the most computing muscle. The article Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: X 上爆發了一場關於人工智慧監管的公開鬥爭。投資者 Gavin Baker、前白宮顧問 David Sacks 和 Meta 研究員 Yann LeCun 指責 Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 使用恐懼言論為自己贏得監管優勢。阿莫代反駁說，監管也可以限制企業權力，而開放模型本身只會將權力轉移給擁有最強計算能力的參與者。 Anthropic 執行長表示人工智慧本質上是中心化的，開放模型只是將權力轉移給擁有晶片的人，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: As AI beats doctors, regulators shouldn't force a human into the loop, JAMA piece says
items_all_raw.summary: An opinion piece in the medical journal JAMA argues that autonomous AI will soon outperform any doctor-AI team at medical reasoning tasks. The authors warn against writing a doctor's final say into regulation, but concede that almost all the evidence comes from simulations, not real patient care. The article As AI beats doctors, regulators shouldn't force a human into the loop, JAMA piece says appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 醫學雜誌《美國醫學會雜誌》上的一篇評論文章認為，自主人工智慧很快就會在醫學推理任務上超越任何醫生人工智慧團隊。作者警告不要將醫生的最終決定權寫入監管，但承認幾乎所有證據都來自模擬，而不是真正的患者護理。 《JAMA》文章稱，《人工智慧擊敗醫生，監管機構不應強迫人類進入循環》一文首先出現在《解碼器》上。

items_all_raw.title: DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards
items_all_raw.summary: Andreessen Horowitz is the focus of an antitrust probe by the US Justice Department. The charge is that the firm's partners sit on the boards of competing data firms Databricks and Fivetran at the same time. The venture capital firm's close ties to the Trump administration add a twist, since it has actively lobbied for the administration's AI deregulation. The article DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 安德森霍洛維茨是美國司法部反壟斷調查的焦點。指控是該公司的合夥人同時擔任競爭資料公司 Databricks 和 Fivetran 的董事會成員。這家風險投資公司與特朗普政府的密切關係增添了一些曲折，因為它一直積極遊說政府放鬆對人工智慧的管制。美國司法部調查安德森·霍洛維茨 (Andreessen Horowitz) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas
items_all_raw.summary: Cartesia has released Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models rather than transformers. It now ranks #1 on both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards — 1,283 Elo on Provider Voice and 1,123 on Controlled Voice, the board that clones every model onto the same eight reference voices to isolate the synthesis engine. Cartesia states sub-90ms time-to-first-audio. The model is available in beta on Cartesia's own API The post Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Cartesia 釋出了 Sonic-3.6，這是一種基於狀態空間模型而不是 Transformer 構建的流式文字到語音模型。現在，它在人工分析語音排行榜上均排名第一，在 Provider Voice 上排名 1,283 Elo，在 Controlled Voice 上排名 1,123，該排行榜將每個模型克隆到相同的八個參考語音上以隔離合成引擎。 Cartesia 表示首個音訊的時間低於 90 毫秒。該模型已在 Cartesia 自己的 API 上提供測試版。Cartesia 釋出了 Sonic-3.6：目前引領人工分析語音競技場的流式 TTS 模型，該模型首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all_raw.title: Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal
items_all_raw.summary: With the /design command, Anthropic brings a visual design workflow directly into Claude Code. Developers can generate UI mockups as artboards right in the terminal before writing any code. Claude reads the existing codebase and matches the current UI style. The article Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 透過 /design 命令，Anthropic 將視覺化設計工作流程直接引入 Claude Code。開發人員可以在編寫任何程式碼之前在終端中生成 UI 模型作為畫板。 Claude 讀取現有的程式碼庫並匹配當前的 UI 風格。文章 Claude Code 獲取 /design 命令，讓開發人員可以直接在終端中建立 UI 模型，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

Describing its own cybersecurity results, the Beijing company writes that capability “is growing fastest exactly where we are furthest behind.” Zhipu, which also trades as Z.ai, is one of a handful of Chinese labs releasing models that compete with […] The post Reading Zhipu’s GLM-5.3 results past the headline number appeared first on AI News .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: GLM-5.3 的 智譜的 發行說明包含一個未納入大部分報道的句子。這家北京公司在描述自己的網路安全成果時寫道，能力“增長最快的地方正是我們落後的地方。” 智譜（也稱為 智譜）是少數幾個釋出與 [...] 競爭模型的中國實驗室之一。閱讀 智譜的 GLM-5.3 結果超過標題數字的帖子首先出現在 AI News 上。

items_all_raw.title: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
items_all_raw.summary: When AI systems condense long conversations, they drop an average of 83 percent of user rules, like "don't send emails without my approval." Penn State researchers propose a small add-on module built on Qwen3.5-9B that preserves over 90 percent of these restrictions. The article AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 當人工智慧系統壓縮長對話時，它們平均會放棄 83% 的使用者規則，例如“未經我批准，請勿傳送電子郵件”。賓夕法尼亞州立大學的研究人員提出了一個基於 Qwen3.5-9B 構建的小型附加模組，該模組保留了 90% 以上的限制。文章《人工智慧系統在壓縮上下文時悄悄地丟棄使用者指令》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。
